info.name: Staff Attendance Policy Management APIs
info.description:
Comprehensive APIs for Staff Attendance Policies based on HR Attendance Policy configuration UI.

Covers:
- Top Metrics (Total Policies, Active, Employees Covered)
- Policy Listing with Filters & Pagination
- Tab 1: General & Applicability Mappings (Roles, Departments, Employees)
- Tab 2: Working Hours, Missing Punch Handling, OD, and Regularisation
- Tab 3: Late Entry, Early Exit, Excessive Lateness & Repeated Violation Slabs
- Tab 4: Review & Publish
- Actions: Duplicate, Create New Version, Archive, Delete

Base path: `/attendancePolicy`

request.description: Returns top 3 summary cards: Total Policies, Active Policies, and Employees Covered count.

query.description: Filter by status: Active, Scheduled, Draft, Archived, All

request.description: Fetches paginated list of policies with mapped categories and employee counts.
Fetches complete details of a single policy including working hours, late/early rules, penalty slabs, and role mappings.
Saves Step 1 (General details and Applicability mappings) and creates a Draft policy.
Updates existing Step 1 details and mappings for policyId 1.
Saves Step 2: Minimum hours (Full Day = 450 min / 7h30m, Half Day = 240 min / 4h), missing punch handling, On-Duty settings, and regularisation window.

request.description: Saves Step 3: Late grace period, Early exit grace period, excessive delays, daily safeguard cap, and repeated violation impact slabs.

Clones the policy along with its working hours, late/early rules, penalty slabs, and role mappings with status Draft.
Creates a new version record of the policy with specified version number and effective start date in Draft status.
